hooks.command:
tmpfile=$(mktemp); git_dir=$(git rev-parse --git-dir 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$git_dir" ]; then rm -f "$tmpfile"; exit 0; fi; head_state="$git_dir/codex-last-reviewed-head"; uncommitted_state="$git_dir/codex-last-reviewed-uncommitted-hash"; head_sha=$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain -- . ':(exclude).claude' 2>/dev/null)" ]; then diff_hash=$( { printf 'HEAD:%s
' "$head_sha"; git diff --cached -- . ':(exclude).claude' 2>/dev/null; git diff -- . ':(exclude).claude' 2>/dev/null; while IFS= read -r -d '' entry; do status="${entry:0:2}"; path="${entry:3}"; if [ "${path#.claude/}" != "$path" ]; then continue; fi; if [ "$status" = "??" ]; then printf '=== %s ===
' "$path"; cat "$path" 2>/dev/null; fi; done < <(git status --porcelain=v1 -z --untracked-files=all 2>/dev/null); } | shasum | awk '{print $1}' ); last_hash=$(cat "$uncommitted_state" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$diff_hash" ] && [ "$diff_hash" = "$last_hash" ]; then rm -f "$tmpfile"; exit 0; fi; codex exec review --uncommitted --skip-git-repo-check -o "$tmpfile" >/dev/null 2>&1; codex_exit=$?; if [ "$codex_exit" -eq 0 ]; then echo "$diff_hash" > "$uncommitted_state"; fi; else last_sha=$(cat "$head_state" 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$head_sha" ] || [ "$head_sha" = "$last_sha" ]; then rm -f "$tmpfile"; exit 0; fi; codex exec review --commit HEAD --skip-git-repo-check -o "$tmpfile" >/dev/null 2>&1; codex_exit=$?; if [ "$codex_exit" -eq 0 ]; then echo "$head_sha" > "$head_state"; fi; fi; msg=$(cat "$tmpfile" 2>/dev/null); rm -f "$tmpfile"; if [ -z "$msg" ]; then msg="(codex review 沒有輸出)"; fi; python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.dumps({'systemMessage': 'Codex review:

' + sys.argv[1]}))" "$msg" 2>/dev/null || true
hooks.statusMessage: Codex 正在 review 這輪的變更...
